title: Every automated planted fault is caught by the check that must catch it
user_story: As the owner I want a qualification case to count a detector only when it is shown to fire on a planted fault (agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md B3; RQ-03, RQ-07, RQ-08, RQ-10).

requirements.description: faults.run_suite plants an edited result, an unsupported claim, an interrupted run, a missing model and instructions inside a source through the app's own functions and reports which detector fired; a crash is not detected.
Faults without a deterministic detector (leakage inside agent code, stale or contradictory memory, poisoned skill) are listed as campaign-only and never counted.

inputs: a topic in a disposable project
preconditions: A topic in a disposable project

scenarios.expected: An edited stored gain fails verification
A claim with an unmeasured number is contested
An interrupted run is marked and never rerun
A missing model pauses the mission; nothing else runs
Instructions inside a source stay untrusted data
5 of 5 automated faults detected; 4 campaign-only faults never counted
A crashing detector is reported as not detected

recovery: Fix the detector, never the fault; never count a campaign-only fault. TASK-FAULTS-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Disposable PHDLAB_DATA_DIR with real protocols, runs, missions, claims and sources (tests/_env.py); evidence in docs/qa/evidence/faults-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on e4a6b0f, all failing (no fault suite). GREEN: 7/7.
